sn22.97:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.97:1.3: atthi nu kho bhante kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:1.4: atthi nu kho bhante kāci vedanā yā vedanā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:1.5: atthi nu kho bhante kāci saññā …pe…
sn22.97:1.6: keci saṅkhārā ye saṅkhārā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti.
sn22.97:1.7: atthi nu kho bhante kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
sn22.97:1.8: natthi kho bhikkhu kiñci rūpaṃ yaṃ rūpaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:1.12: kiñci viññāṇaṃ yaṃ viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassatīti.
sn22.97:2.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn22.97:2.2: ettakaṃpi kho bhikkhu rūpaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:2.3: ettakaṃpi ce bhikkhu rūpaṃ abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:2.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakaṃpi rūpaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:3.1: ettakāpi kho bhikkhu vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassati.
sn22.97:3.2: ettakāpi ce bhikkhu vedanā abhavissa niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:3.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakāpi vedanā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:4.2: ettakāpi kho bhikkhu saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassanti.
sn22.97:4.3: ettakā cepi bhikkhu saṅkhārā abhavissaṃsu niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:4.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakāpi saṅkhārā natthi niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya.

sn22.97:5.2: ettakaṃ cepi bhikkhu viññāṇaṃ abhavissa niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ na yidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammādukkhakkhayāya.
sn22.97:5.3: yasmā ca kho bhikkhu ettakaṃpi viññāṇaṃ natthi niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammādukkhakkhayāya.
